slides.texte_overlay:
What to do the night
before a big day
Prepare everything you need. Clothes, documents, bag, keys. Laying it out the night before removes stress from the morning.
Plan your route and timing. Check the address and leave extra time. Arriving early calms your nerves for whatever comes next.
Eat a normal dinner. Nothing too heavy or new. Your body should feel comfortable, not surprised. Keep it short and simple.
Do a short review, not a full cram. Look over your key points once, then stop. Rest helps you remember better than panic.
Calm your mind with something different. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it takes my head off tomorrow for a moment.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It takes my head off tomorrow for a moment.

slides.texte_overlay: Go to bed at your normal time. Going to bed too early often means lying awake. Keep your rhythm. Trust your routine.
Remind yourself why you're ready. Write down three things you've done to prepare. Confidence comes from preparation, not luck.
